health.ollamaUnreachable: Ollama can't be reached. You can still build templates, but reading filled forms needs Ollama — start it with “ollama serve”.
health.modelMissing: The model {{model}} isn't installed in Ollama. Install it with “ollama pull {{model}}”.

upload.acceptedTypes: PNG, JPG, TIFF, WebP or PDF, up to {{maxSize}} MB. For PDFs, only the first page is used.
upload.tooLarge: This file is larger than {{maxSize}} MB. Choose a smaller file.
upload.unsupportedType: This file type isn't supported. Choose a PNG, JPG, TIFF, WebP or PDF file.

errors.network_error: The server can't be reached. Check that the backend is running and try again.
errors.invalid_response: The server sent an unexpected response. Try again, or contact support if it keeps happening.
errors.unsupported_file: This file couldn't be read as an image or PDF.
errors.file_too_large: This file is too large to upload.
errors.template_not_found: This template doesn't exist anymore. It may have been deleted.
errors.draft_not_found: The scanned blank form has expired. Upload it again.
errors.field_outside_image: A field box goes outside the form image. Move or resize it so it fits.
errors.missing_form_pages_one: The scan is missing page {{pages}} of the form, which has fields to fill in. Scan every form page and try again. Terms and conditions pages can be left out.
errors.missing_form_pages_other: The scan is missing pages {{pages}} of the form, which have fields to fill in. Scan every form page and try again. Terms and conditions pages can be left out.
errors.ocr_engine_unavailable: The OCR model isn't available. Check that Ollama is running and the models are installed.
